name: Norethisterone
mechanism: Synthetic progestogen with weak androgenic and estrogenic activity
dosing: Menorrhagia: 5mg TDS for 10 days. Contraception: 350mcg daily. Endometriosis: 10-15mg daily
contraindications: Pregnancy, severe liver disease, thromboembolism, breast cancer
monitoring: Breakthrough bleeding, weight, mood, thrombotic risk factors
sideEffects: Weight gain, mood changes, breakthrough bleeding, acne, androgenic effects
clinicalPearls: Multiple indications and doses. Weak androgenic effects. Can delay menstruation
indication: Menorrhagia, endometriosis, contraception (POP), HRT, delayed menstruation
